messages:
maria (finance): HelixGrid INV-2026-3050 for $27,450 shows unpaid and AP says they're withholding payment due to a usage discrepancy. Can AE confirm who at HelixGrid we should chase?

ben (acct-exec): I reached out to Oliver at ap@helixgrid.com. He replied they received two duplicate job-run records and opened an internal ticket, so treasury is holding 30% until reconciliation completes. Asked for ETA.

oliver (HelixGrid AP): Correct — procurement flagged duplicate runs on 03/02-03 and asked for our ops team to confirm. We initiated inquiry and won't release the final 30% until ops confirms billing lines; treasury will pay the remaining 70% if we get confirmation within 7 business days.

maria (finance): We can accept a partial payment to avoid service disruption. For collections: we need 70% ($19,215) posted by 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC with masked remittance proof to pause the suspension. Can you commit to finishing the reconciliation within 14 days so we can close the invoice?

nora (revops): Ops team ran the job logs and found two overlapping retry jobs that produced duplicate billed tokens. We can provide a reconciled usage file (CSV) and a short summary of adjustments within 72 hours. If HelixGrid accepts our reconciliation, we can issue a credit memo to offset the disputed amount.

oliver (HelixGrid AP): That's helpful. Accepting the reconciliation would let us release the 30% hold. Two asks: 1) we need the reconciled CSV and a short note on how amounts were adjusted; 2) we need the finance team to apply the credit memo before we release remaining funds. Can you confirm workflow?

maria (finance): Workflow: revops uploads reconciled CSV + summary in this thread; finance will review and, if it matches, post a credit memo for the disputed lines. We require a 70% partial payment first to avoid immediate hold, then we will apply the credit against the outstanding remainder once approved. Also offering a one-time administrative concession: if full balance (net of credit) is cleared within 14 days after credit memo, we'll waive the standard $250 reinstatement fee.

ben (acct-exec): Noted. @oliver please confirm acceptance of that concession and post PTP (promise to pay) for the 70% by 04/05. I'll send the payment instructions now.

oliver (HelixGrid AP): HelixGrid accepts the concession and PTP. Treasury will push 70% via ACH 04/05 morning and we'll upload masked remittance here. We'll review revops CSV and respond within 72 hours.

laura (legal): Quick legal note: per the Master Agreement disputes clause, disputed amounts may be withheld for a reasonable period while parties investigate. Please document the PTP and CSV in account notes. If reconciliation extends beyond 30 days without resolution, collections escalation triggers per policy.

reminders-bot: Reminder: Billing hold scheduled for account "helix-grid" on 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC if outstanding balance > $0. Use `/payments check INV-2026-3050` to refresh.

nora (revops): Uploading reconciled usage (masked) and a short summary now: "CSV: runs-dedup-2026-03.csv (removed duplicate retries). Adjustment: -$6,540 disputed tokens reduced. Net due after credit: $20,910."

maria (finance): Received the CSV and summary. I'll run a quick check and post a provisional credit memo for $6,540 if figures line up with ledger. Ben, please expect the remittance screenshot from HelixGrid tomorrow.

ben (acct-exec): Got it. Sent payment instructions earlier. Copy: ```
Account: ****-7788
Ref: INV-2026-3050 / HG-PO-2211
Amount: $19,215
```

oliver (HelixGrid AP): Bank confirms ACH scheduled 04/05 08:30 UTC. Will upload masked remittance after bank confirms posting. Thanks for working through the recon.

maria (finance): Great — once the 70% shows I'll mark the hold pending settlement and apply the provisional credit memo, then we can reconcile final net amount. Keep thread updated if reconciliation reveals any further variance.

laura (legal): Documenting PTP and timelines. If HelixGrid misses the 04/05 PTP, we'll proceed with the standard collections workflow.

reminders-bot: Payment for INV-2026-3050 is set to pending once remittance posted. Run `/payments refresh 2205001234` to check final posting.

ben (acct-exec): Uploaded masked remittance screenshot from bank: "REMIT: ACH - ****7788 - INV-2026-3050 - AMT $19,215 - REF TXN-HG-331"

maria (finance): Received. Clearing pending hold and applying provisional credit memo for $6,540. Final net due: $20,910. We'll re-audit in 14 days; if everything reconciles we'll close the invoice. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
